Женамеат.definition: Женамеат if [translated] from Russian Жена, Meaning Wife and меат being a transliteration of Meat so it means Wifemeat; But it is used in many ways. To replace curse words, As another [way to say] Dude,Bro,Man, et cetera and to replace various words in a sentence to make it more [confusing].
Женамеат.example: Hey Женамеат what was the name of that book we were [suppose] to read?" "A [little] Женамеат on the [prairie]." "What?

Женподин.definition:
Russian version of "femboy"
[Combines] Женский ([Feminine]) + Господин (Mister/Mr.) = Женподин (Femboy)
Spelled "Zhenpodin" in latin
[Pronounced] "zhen-pa-deen" (Zhen as in Jen, the name, but like a softer J, like a zh sound, slavics will know)
Yes, you could just say "Фембои" instead, but this is much cooler
Женподин.example:
[Michael]: I'm a silly [little] [femboy] UwU
Михаил: Я глупый маленький женподин ЦшЦ
